title: CardCorpus moved addresses
description: Every address that was published and no longer resolves, and what became of it: merged into another, moved to another, split into several (every successor, none picked), or removed. An id never changes once published and a retired address is never given to anything else, so a consumer only needs this file when a stored pointer stops resolving. Each successor is the current address, any chain already followed (docs/static-api.md, "Ids").

moved.description: Every retired address, with what became of it.

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `set` or `card` or `product` or `variant` or `product-variant` or `painting`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (docs/static-api.md, "Pointers").

card.description: The card's id, unique in its set.

product.description: The sealed product's id, unique in its set.

variant.description: The copy's id, unique among its card's (or product's) variants.

painting.description: The painting's id, unique in its set's paintings file: its first print's card id.

merged.description: The address it was merged into.
